processing: Masters were generated or reference-edited with Codex image generation and retain alpha for all figurines. The 2026-10-17 controller-QA fix reference-edited both queens, knights and rooks from their accepted masters; kings, bishops, pawns, board and picker were preserved. build_qa.py crops only alpha >= 8 for bounds, preserves antialiased RGBA pixels, and bottom-centres types into lossless 160x160 WebPs at the approved occupied-height ladder: King 88%, Queen 84%, Bishop 78%, Knight 75%, Rook 70%, Pawn 58%. Its 60 px greyscale-blur plate now preserves painted luminance instead of flattening every piece to black, so it tests side contrast as well as blurred recognition. The 2048x2048 board master was resampled from the accepted generated square render before the 1024x1024 runtime export. The picker runtime is 480x640. The accepted story render was resampled to a 1600x1200 PNG master, then exported by build_qa.py as exact 1200x900 quality-85 WebP; story-review.jpg places it beside the six Dawn runtime identities.
